parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Taken from Table 3, Reconciliations of Net Income to Adjusted EBITDA (dollars in millions), for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025. The definitions section calls it Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA. The component total row ('Total Adjusted EBITDA $ 230.4 $ 208.0') matches. Segment figures are excluded. No year-to-date figures beyond the quarter are shown.
